items.title: How I Fight AI Brain Fry

extra.evidence: If you work with Claude Code or Codex from the terminal, you know this one. You start a task. The AI takes time to reply, so you start another one. Then the first one replies, but the reply needs one clarification, one follow up and one side task — and each of them wants its own tab. Then the second tab's reply comes in. You juggle. items.title: Agent memory needs its OpenTelemetry moment

extra.evidence: Every agent tool stores memory in its own shape, and every week someone builds another one. None of them can read the others. Observability had the same problem until OpenTelemetry gave everyone one data model to share. A tour of today's memory formats, the proposals that already exist, and what a shared spec could look like. List every place your coding tools keep something they "remember". A typical setup today: That's four different shapes, and none of them can read the others . A lesson your CI agent learns stays in whatever wrote it. Your editor agent can't read it, and neither can the next tool you try. Each format is reasonable on its own. Together, they rebuild the same small idea again and again: a note an agent left for its future self, stored at some address, true for a while.…

items.title: 终端侧AI：从单点应用走向智能体体验
items.summary: 高通在第九届进博会展出端侧MoE智能体

extra.evidence: 高通在第九届进博会展出端侧MoE智能体 从应用来看，终端侧AI并不是从大模型开始的。影像其实是AI较早在终端落地的领域之一。近年来手机拍照效果不断提升，背后就有终端侧AI技术的推动。如今，终端侧AI已经进一步拓展到简单问答、聊天、图像生成与处理，以及文本处理、语音转录、实时翻译等多模态应用，其中不少功能在端侧落地的条件已经比较成熟。 不过，目前很多端侧AI应用仍然偏向单点功能。例如自动语音识别（ASR）、文本摘要、图片处理、简单聊天机器人等，大多解决的是一个具体任务。如果未来希望终端能够进一步完成意图理解、任务编排、实时操作目标App等系统级、规划类任务，就需要更强的端侧模型能力。 高通并不强调端侧的唯一性，而是强调端云协同或者“计算连续体”，其中一个重要思路是“端侧优先”（on-device first）。 传统依赖云端的AI服务，每一次推理都需要消耗云端Token、GPU以及云端调度资源，同时依赖网络连接。如果将合适的AI能力部署到端侧，则可以减少对网络的依赖，提供更加及时和稳定的响应，同时发挥终端在安全、隐私和个性化方面的优势。 如果用一个比较直观的比喻来理解：云端更像一个“通用知识库”，端侧则拥有更多属于用户个人的“专业化知识”。 端侧可以结合用户是谁、在哪里、过去做过什么，以及当前所处的环境，对用户接下来可能需要的服务作出判断，这也是“主动式AI服务”的基础。 因此，端侧并不是孤立的体系。云端可以承接需要更强智能和计算能力的任务，端侧则能够发挥实时、稳定、隐私以及个性化等优势，二者相互协同。 MoE全称为Mixture of Experts，即混合专家模型。理解MoE，可以先把它和传统Dense模型进行比较。 以一个30亿参数的Dense模型为例，每完成一次推理，30亿参数都需要运行一遍，才能得到最终输出。 MoE的工作方式有所不同。它将模型中的参数划分为多个不…

items.title: Agent 越用越多，企业为何仍不够 AI Native？

extra.evidence: 工具解决局部，瓶颈落在价值 AI 生码率飙升，端到端交付却没有变快；通用 Agent 提效办公生产力，整体业务效能却未同步提升。当企业把 AI 工具推向业务流程，“局部更快、整体不快”的现象值得审视。阿里云智能集团副总裁、CIO 蒋林泉复盘了三年 AI 实践，从问题中找到了答案，也对 AI Native 有了清晰的认识。 围绕 AI Native 的，还有一长串概念——AI 生码率、Token Maxxing、编程智能体、通用智能体、一人公司、10 倍效率、全自动编程、数字员工、Agentic Workflow。 一个词用多了，似乎就容易“腐败”：含义被稀释，都在说，却谁也说不清。这是蒋林泉对概念泛化的提醒。 他的追问是： Token 用得越多，就越 AI Native 吗？用上了 Vibe Coding，就算 AI Native 的产研组织吗？用上了通用智能体，就是 AI Native 的业务团队吗？ 这些指向同一个问题： 工具的使用量，并不能直接证明组织形态发生了变化。 AI Native 其实是组织层面的问题——什么样的组织，才算得上 AI Native？ 他把对 AI Native 的定义与过去三年的实践放在一起讨论：从 CIO 线自身的产研组织变革，到支撑业务团队，再到把内部能力变成对外交付的产品。 过程中，AI Native 必须同时发生在系统与组织两侧，CIO 与 CPO 的联动也由此成为关键。工具定义能力边界，组织决定这些能力能否进入真实工作、形成有效协作，并最终创造业务价值。 从 2024 年底，蒋林泉的团队已经全员用上 AI 编码工具，那时生码率就很快上到 30% 多。 但是，当时有个现象让他警觉：端到端交付一个需求所消耗的人力，没有变化。后来与业界很多产研团队交流，大家都发现了同样的问题—— AI 生码率和代码量持续增长，真实业务项目的 E2E 耗时…

items.title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
items.summary: Target-conditioned diffusion drafters predict candidate tokens in parallel, yet each new block must wait for updated target-model hidden states. This forces drafting and verification to run sequentially, limiting speedup even though each block is generated in one pass. We introduce D3D, a standalone diffusion drafter that removes this inter-round dependency. D3D combines blockwise denoising with auxiliary autoregressive supervision to achieve long accepted prefixes without target hidden states. This independence lets D3D draft successor blocks during verification in one packed pass, enabling asynchronous speculative decoding. We progressively prune layers according to their effect on acceptance length to reduce the cost of packed drafting. Removing five of 36 layers retains over 99\% of mean acceptance length across three benchmarks with Qwen3-8B as the target. Across seven benchmarks, D3D averages 5.00$\times$ and 5.71$\times$ decoding speedup with Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B targets, compared with 4.03$\times$ and 3.67$\times$ for DFlash. On GSM8K with Qwen3-32B, speedup reaches 7.48$\times$. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/fudan-generative-vision/D3D.
items.title_zh: D3D：异步推测解码的解耦扩散草稿
items.summary_zh: D3D提出了一种独立的扩散草稿模型，通过结合分块去噪和辅助自回归监督，在无需目标模型隐藏状态的情况下实现长前缀接受。该方法允许草稿和验证并行进行，从而加速解码。实验表明，D3D在多个基准测试中实现了显著的解码加速。

items.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
items.summary: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose $\textbf{LoopVQ}$, a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly, and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. At 0.5 bits per element, LoopVQ outperforms existing KV cache vector quantization methods for standard LLMs on general, long chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval tasks with Ouro and Huginn models. Its design is orthogonal to these methods, and combined with TaSQ, it retains much of the BF16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. We also implement LoopVQ in SGLang, where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32K-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to $4.3\times$ and $6.1\times$ on the 1.4B and 2.6B Ouro models compared to the BF16 baselin…
items.title_zh: LoopVQ：循环Transformer的亚1比特KV缓存量化
items.summary_zh: LoopVQ针对循环Transformer的KV缓存提出了一种向量量化方法，通过联合编码多个循环步骤的通道并微调码本，在保持精度的同时大幅减少内存占用。该方法在0.5比特每元素时优于现有方法，并显著降低了解码延迟。

items.title: Confucius4-R2T2: A Stable-Prefix Streaming ASR Model for Real Real-Time Transcription
items.summary: Streaming speech recognition is increasingly consumed by machines, such as translators and voice agents, that act on each token as it appears. A token that is later revised costs wasted work or a wrong action. In this work, we present Confucius4-R2T2 (short for Real Real-Time Transcription), a stable-prefix streaming ASR model that never modifies its earlier output while maintaining high accuracy and low latency. R2T2 is obtained by post-training Qwen3-ASR-1.7B on 1,500 hours of Chinese and English audio while freezing its pre-trained audio encoder and projector. The adaptation is based on the concept of Longest Stable Prefix (LSP), a new notion that we introduce in this work. We prove that LSP is monotone under the prefix order, consistent with the full-audio output, and maximal among labels that equal a whole earlier output. Learning from LSP labels converts a full-context model into a stable-prefix streaming one without any architectural change. Extensive evaluations show that R2T2 brings streaming recognition close to the base model's full-context quality while delivering stable text with low emission lag. Its gains extend beyond the post-training languages, demonstrating a practical path from full-context ASR to stable streaming. We open-source the model weights and code at https://huggingface.co/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2 and https://github.com/netease-youdao/Confucius4-R2T2.
items.title_zh: Confucius4-R2T2：实时转录的稳定前缀流式ASR模型
items.summary_zh: Confucius4-R2T2通过引入最长稳定前缀概念，在冻结预训练音频编码器和投影器的情况下，将全上下文ASR模型转化为稳定前缀流式模型。该模型在保持高精度的同时，确保输出稳定且延迟低，适用于实时转录场景。

items.title: Tools Need Not Speak in Text: Latent Context Compression for Agents
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents typically append raw tool outputs to their context. Over multi-step interactions, long and noisy observations incur substantial context overhead and dilute the agent's attention to task-relevant information. Existing token pruning and summarization methods remain constrained by discrete text representations, limiting the achievable compression ratios. In this work, we challenge the prevailing assumption that agents must consume tool observations as explicit text tokens. To this end, we propose Coca-Cola, a continuous latent context compression model for LLM agents. Coca-Cola compresses tool observations into latent tokens and embeds them into the input embedding space of the agent. We further introduce Action-Preserving Training, which aligns the agent's next-action distributions under full and compressed observations. This trains the compression model to learn action-sufficient latent tokens that retain decision-critical information. Experiments with web-search agents on four QA benchmarks and two model families show that Coca-Cola reduces the agent's token consumption by 70.01%-89.24% and end-to-end runtime by 24.45%-55.97%, while consistently improving task performance. These results suggest that Coca-Cola offers a promising approach for context compression in agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/THU-Agent/Coca-cola.

items.summary_zh: Coca-Cola提出了一种连续潜在上下文压缩模型，将工具输出压缩为潜在令牌并嵌入智能体的输入嵌入空间。通过动作保持训练，该模型在减少令牌消耗和运行时间的同时，显著提升了任务性能。

items.title: Signed but Steerable: Measuring and Closing the Text-Vector Integrity Gap in Offline Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.summary: Offline retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices is updated through signed knowledge packs that carry text and precomputed embedding vectors. A signature proves who published a pack, not that its vectors encode its text. We study this text-vector integrity gap. A verifier that recomputes vectors and accepts them within a cosine tolerance concedes a predictable share of queries to an attacker who controls the vectors: the hijack rate equals the distribution of angular retrieval margins at the tolerance (the margin law). Margins are small in five corpora and two embedding models, so an idealised tolerance at the level of floating-point noise leaves up to 5.5% of queries exposed (at most 1.2% in any corpus once exact duplicate documents are excluded), and a threshold calibrated from our CPU INT8-FP32 comparison of a small embedding model (at the empirical 0.1% quantile of honest cosines) leaves 98-100% exposed; on a Raspberry Pi 5 running a local language model, such an attack lowers correct answers from 0.75 to 0.39. Integrity audits of compressed vector stores fare no better: on a FAISS product-quantisation index over 57,638 documents, tampered vectors that all pass the audit put the attacker's document first for 25% of targets. Verifying quantisation codes instead, with ambiguity decided by the verifier, a calibrated guard band and canonicalisation, accepted every honest vector in our samples on three platforms and left the publisher no choice. We also show that…
